India.notes: Stamp paper often used; not strictly required for digital freelance agreements.

USA.notes: ESIGN and UETA Acts ensure enforceability; signatures can be typed.

Philippines.notes: Freelancer contracts governed by Civil Code; e-signatures valid.

Pakistan.notes: Stamp paper or notarization may strengthen contract enforceability.

Bangladesh.notes: Legal recognition under ICT Act; cultural preference for written copies.

UK.notes: Digital contracts enforceable; ensure clarity and fairness.

Ukraine.notes: English may work between parties, but Ukrainian translation may be needed in disputes.

Russia.notes: E-signatures only valid with certified Russian providers; translation required.

Brazil.notes: English valid with consent, but local consumer laws may override terms.

Serbia.notes: Translations may be required for court use; signatures are binding electronically.
